claims.claim: After talks with Israel, the UK said its Consulate General building in Jerusalem will not close and will be known from today as the UK Mission, Jerusalem.
claims.episode_span: the Consulate General building will not close and will be known from today as the UK Mission, Jerusalem
claims.source_title: Foreign Secretary statement on the UK's diplomatic presence in Jerusalem
claims.supporting_quote: Following discussions with the Government of Israel, our Consulate General building will not be closing, and will be known as the UK Mission, Jerusalem from today

claims.claim: The UK government said it does not accept that Israel has the legal right to close the British Consulate General, which has been there for nearly 200 years, and restated that East Jerusalem is occupied territory.
claims.episode_span: does not accept that Israel has the legal right to close the British Consulate General, there for nearly 200 years
claims.source_title: Foreign Secretary statement on the UK's diplomatic presence in Jerusalem
claims.supporting_quote: We have been clear that we do not accept that the Government of Israel has the legal right to close the British Consulate General in Jerusalem, which has been there for nearly 200 years.

claims.claim: The UK said the mission remains independent and operational, will continue services and work with the Palestinian people, and supports a two-state solution.
claims.episode_span: independent and operational and will keep delivering services and work with the Palestinian people
claims.source_title: Foreign Secretary statement on the UK's diplomatic presence in Jerusalem
claims.supporting_quote: The UK Mission, Jerusalem is independent, operational, and will continue to deliver vital services and our work with the Palestinian people.

claims.claim: The UK temporarily withdrew a number of staff and families and said it will not take reciprocal action while discussions are underway and credible.
claims.episode_span: temporarily withdrawn a number of staff and families
claims.source_title: Foreign Secretary statement on the UK's diplomatic presence in Jerusalem
claims.supporting_quote: Accordingly, the UK has temporarily withdrawn a number of staff and families to ensure their safety and security.

claims.claim: The UK said it stands by measures taken on 8 September with international partners in support of a two-state solution.
claims.episode_span: stands by measures taken on 8 September with international partners
claims.source_title: Foreign Secretary statement on the UK's diplomatic presence in Jerusalem
claims.supporting_quote: The UK stands steadfast by the measures we took on 8 September, in concert with the international community, in support of a two-state solution to deliver peace and security for the people of Israel and Palestine.

claims.claim: Sky News reported that Israel confirmed it is closing the British consulate in East Jerusalem after a UK ban on trade with West Bank settlements Sky described as illegal.
claims.episode_span: Israel has confirmed it is closing the British consulate in East Jerusalem after a UK ban on trade with West Bank settlements, which Sky described as illegal
claims.source_title: Israel confirms it is closing the British consulate in East Jerusalem after UK ban on trade with illegal West Bank settlements.
claims.supporting_quote: Israel confirms it is closing the British consulate in East Jerusalem after UK ban on trade with illegal West Bank settlements.

claims.claim: PET analyst Josefine Christensen said Russia has begun sabotage against Danish companies supplying military equipment to Ukraine after broader disruption efforts failed.
claims.episode_span: Russia has begun sabotage against Danish firms supplying military equipment to Ukraine
claims.source_title: Russia Steps Up Sabotage Attacks on Danish Defense Firms, Intelligence Says
claims.supporting_quote: Russia has begun sabotage operations against Danish companies supplying military equipment to Ukraine after concluding that broader efforts to disrupt Western support for Kyiv had failed, Josefine Christensen, a lead analyst at Denmark’s Security and Intelligence Service (PET), said Wednesday.

claims.claim: Christensen said spring brought much planning and little action, while early summer brought many more operations, and that Moscow is now targeting weapons production.
claims.episode_span: spring saw a lot of planning and very little carried out, while early summer saw many more operations
claims.source_title: Russia Steps Up Sabotage Attacks on Danish Defense Firms, Intelligence Says
claims.supporting_quote: “What we saw in the spring was a lot of planning, but very little carried out; what we saw in early summer is that they started to carry out a lot more,” Christensen said, according to Reuters.

claims.claim: PET says Russia is using untrained proxies recruited via Telegram, including homeless people and people addicted to drugs, and Christensen cited an April Russian Defense Ministry list of European drone makers.
claims.episode_span: untrained proxies recruited through Telegram, including homeless people and people addicted to drugs
claims.source_title: Russia Steps Up Sabotage Attacks on Danish Defense Firms, Intelligence Says
claims.supporting_quote: Russia is increasingly relying on untrained proxies recruited through Telegram and other social media platforms, including homeless people and people addicted to drugs, according to PET.

claims.claim: The Russian Embassy in Copenhagen rejected the allegations as unfounded, and Russia has repeatedly denied involvement in sabotage or hybrid warfare.
claims.episode_span: The Russian Embassy in Copenhagen rejected the allegations Wednesday as unfounded claims
claims.source_title: Russia Steps Up Sabotage Attacks on Danish Defense Firms, Intelligence Says
claims.supporting_quote: The Russian Embassy in Copenhagen rejected the allegations Wednesday, accusing Danish authorities of making unfounded claims against Russia.

claims.claim: The Guardian reported French youth protests over crumbling schools and teacher shortages, a Paris placard saying school is a right not a privilege, and tens of thousands in the streets, with further strikes planned today.
claims.episode_span: School is a right, not a privilege
claims.source_title: Thursday briefing: Why young people are taking to the streets across France
claims.supporting_quote: “School is a right, not a privilege,” read one such sign held aloft by a student in Paris, where huge youth protests over the state of high school education have brought tens of thousands of young people and adults on to the streets, with further strikes planned today.

claims.claim: Euronews reported that trade unions joined French demonstrations on Tuesday that drew more than 250,000 people, with students bracing for another major day.
claims.episode_span: drew more than 250,000 people across the country
claims.source_title: Europe Today: Rubio urges Europe to wake up as EU trade chief begins key China trip
claims.supporting_quote: Estelle Nilsson-Julien reports from Paris on the student protests in France, as they brace for another major day on the streets after trade unions joined demonstrations that drew more than 250,000 people across the country on Tuesday.

claims.claim: Ukraine's State Emergency Service said the Pryluky death toll had risen to 22, including five children, and Kyiv Post reported at least 32 people killed in Wednesday's Russian strikes, with two more bodies found in Kyiv.
claims.episode_span: the Pryluky toll had risen to 22, including five children
claims.source_title: Putin’s Birthday Strikes Kill at Least 32 Ukrainians, Including 5 Children, as More Bodies Found in Kyiv
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine’s State Emergency Service (DSNS) reported Thursday morning that the death toll in Pryluky had risen to 22, while the discovery of two additional victims in Kyiv brought the reported toll from the capital’s latest attacks to four.

claims.claim: A last-minute deal between Kosovo's two biggest parties made Justina Shiroka Pula president and averted another election.
claims.episode_span: made Justina Shiroka Pula president and averted another election
claims.source_title: Justina Shiroka Pula, Another Woman at Kosovo’s Helm
claims.supporting_quote: A last-minute deal between two biggest Kosovo parties saw Justina Shiroka Pula become Kosovo’s President, averting the spectre of yet another election.

claims.claim: Judges, prosecutors and civil society groups condemned an Albanian criminal procedure bill as likely to weaken a key anti-corruption body, while the bill also addresses concerns about pretrial detention.
claims.episode_span: condemned a bill rewriting a large part of Albania's Code of Criminal Procedure
claims.source_title: Albanian Criminal Procedure Bill Slammed as Bid to ‘Neuter’ Anti-Graft Body
claims.supporting_quote: While addressing widely-held concerns about pretrial detention measures, a bill to rewrite a big chunk of Albania’s Code of Criminal Procedure has been met with consternation among judges, prosecutors and civil society groups worried it will ‘neuter’ a key anti-corruption body

claims.claim: The Transition Security Project told The Guardian that almost a quarter of Britain's defence budget is spent on overseas commitments across five continents, and that a planned spending rise is likely to increase waste.
claims.episode_span: almost a quarter of the defence budget spent on commitments across five continents
claims.source_title: UK’s military needs to focus spending on domestic defence, not overseas missions – report
claims.supporting_quote: According to an analysis by researchers at the Transition Security Project, Britain has the most overseas-oriented military among European nations, with almost a quarter of the defence budget spent on commitments across five continents.

claims.claim: EU Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič has arrived in Beijing for a two-day visit seeking to rebalance EU-China trade ahead of the October EU summit.
claims.episode_span: Maroš Šefčovič has arrived in Beijing for a two-day visit seeking to rebalance EU-China trade
claims.source_title: Europe Today: Rubio urges Europe to wake up as EU trade chief begins key China trip
claims.supporting_quote: EU Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič has arrived in Beijing for a crucial two-day visit seeking to rebalance EU-China trade relations, which have become increasingly lopsided in the past decade.

claims.claim: The European Commission approved or renewed authorizations for seven GM soybean and corn events for food and feed, not cultivation, for 10 years, after member states failed to reach a qualified majority either way.
claims.episode_span: approved or renewed authorizations for seven genetically modified crops
claims.source_title: European Commission authorizes imports of seven new GM soybean and corn events
claims.supporting_quote: The European Commission approved or renewed authorizations for seven genetically modified crops in June and September 2026, covering four soybean events and three corn events.

claims.claim: More than 23 million people have a GOV.UK One Login account, and Natalie Jones said the platform has reached 256 services.
claims.episode_span: More than 23 million people now have a GOV.UK One Login account
claims.source_title: One Login could cover every central government service within 18 months, says GDS
claims.supporting_quote: Giving an update on the programme at Think Digital Identity and Cyber Security for Government , Jones (pictured) said One Login has now reached 256 services and more than 23 million users.
